d: Across the world, birthrates are falling, even as populations keep rising for now. This video dives into the paradox: from Japan’s ghost villages and South Korea’s record-low fertility to India’s looming OADR shift, we map how fewer births ripple into schools, jobs, taxes, and power. We unpack the “why” beyond “it’s expensive”: contraception and choice, changing marriage norms, career incentives, hypergamy debates, climate dread and yes, the real rupee cost of raising a child in 2025.
